governance_decision: User explicitly prioritizes Atlas V1 delivery speed over measuring autonomous source discovery versus human discovery.

scientific_reclassification.abandoned_claim: The current run will NOT be used to estimate whether the agent autonomously discovers better source URLs than a human.
scientific_reclassification.retained_question: Given permitted source surfaces, including human-provided seeds, can an Arabic-native multi-agent collector convert them into correct, provenance-complete, bilingual, canonical electoral evidence that deterministic B2 could not use?
scientific_reclassification.future_human_vs_llm_comparison: Reserve human-versus-LLM experimental contrast for E_reason and later predictive residual reasoning, where the comparison is more decision-relevant.

purpose: enumerate structured election assets and interactive-data payloads
recover current 2026 candidate and territory evidence where available
map asset provenance back to Médias24 publication context
initial_human_seeds.instruction: Explore deeply, including referenced JSON/CSV/JS/data endpoints and archived versions when accessible. Treat the root URL as a discovery surface, not automatic factual proof. Every accepted fact still requires a hashable allowed-source artifact and temporal-cutoff compliance.

run_reuse_policy.if_v1_run_already_started: Do not delete or rewrite it. Preserve its run directory and mark it SUPERSEDED_FOR_DISCOVERY_ABLATION. Existing collected evidence may be reused in V1.1 only if provenance is complete and each record is revalidated under the V1.1 source and evidence rules.

unchanged_constraints: allowed evidence sources remain official/institutional Moroccan sources, official Moroccan party sites, Médias24, and archives of those same domains
product_priority: After the 92+16 quality benchmark is adjudicated, proceed directly to production-wide Atlas V1 collection using all qualified human and agent discovered source surfaces.
